_comment: Options Lifecycle Desk policy — VERSIONED. Every decision row records the version that produced it. Edits bump policy_version (semver) with a dated note in policy_changelog. No literals in code; the engine reads only this file. No recommendation may fire solely because P&L is positive — every rule couples profit state to time, risk, or structure state.

policy_changelog.note: initial pre-registration — thresholds seeded from prompt + desk practice, min_sample tuning gate applies before any change proposal

single-primary precedence reducer (DATA_BLOCKED>EXPIRATION_CRITICAL>ASSIGNMENT_CRITICAL>DEFEND>ROLL>ACCEPT_ASSIGNMENT>EXERCISE_REVIEW>HARVEST_FULL>HARVEST_PARTIAL>LET_MATURE>HOLD); assignment/expiration critical recommendations added to the vocabulary; subordinate findings persist inside the primary decision (never independent contradictory alerts); alert identity headers + delivery evidence. Decisions recorded before this version under 1.0.0 predate the reducer — decision_engine_version disambiguates.

quotes.market_hours_only_note: off-hours snapshots are informational; tickets always refetch

cash_secured_put.assignment_ok_hold_note: if operator_objective=assignment_ok, deterioration reads as ACCEPT_ASSIGNMENT review, not DEFEND

assignment.auto_exercise_threshold_note: OCC auto-exercises 0.01 ITM at expiry — expiry-day ITM without review is a failure

tuning.note: no automatic tuning — bounded reviewable proposals only, after min sample

oversight._comment: v1.1 P7: FREE lanes only for configured exceptions; deterministic policy canonical; LLMs advisory-only, no write path into decisions/tickets/2FA/outcomes. paid_enabled stays false until the operator flips it.
